title: Generalized quantum cluster structure of reduced Lê--Roger--Yang skein algebras and their Frobenius maps
summary: We establish a generalized quantum cluster algebra structure, defined by Bai--Chen--Ding--Xu, on the reduced Lê--Roger--Yang skein algebra of every quasi-triangulable punctured surface. We define Frobenius maps for generalized quantum cluster algebras at roots of unity and use these maps, together with the cluster algebra structure, to construct Frobenius maps for the (reduced) Lê--Roger--Yang skein algebras of all punctured surfaces.
